turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to track my sleep for a month, and I'm not sure which way to do it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me describe all the options before you comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Wear a fitness watch to bed, which tracks heart rate and when I wake up.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Use a free app that sits on the mattress and listens for movement and snoring.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or just keep a paper diary on my nightstand, writing bedtime and how rested I feel.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's it. Now you can comment.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The watch gives you the most data without effort, but some people find it uncomfortable at night. The app is free and catches snoring, while the paper diary is surprisingly useful because it records how you actually feel.
